_note: Episode 3 version 2 (the new form). Every still is one full painted picture in the Bakunawa look (the JSON prompt of pipeline/draw_pick.py); 'full' holds each still's JSON prompt (subject, setting, light) from /opt/work/bk/ep03v2/plan.json, 'draw' is null until a draw is chosen. Shot N is still bk_{N-1}. Writing in pictures is added in code after the choice: bk_09 the plaque, bk_50 the episode's question, bk_39 the Acta pages as plain lines. Silent shots are shown inside a neighbouring sentence through a 'keys' montage in shots_fx.json: shot 33 (the vendor weighs him, bk_32) is key 90 inside sentence 71; shot 36 (the hand on the sill, bk_35) is key 91 inside sentence 77, the line that tells it; shot 42 (hats in the sky, bk_41) is key 92 inside sentence 85, after the shout. Shot 52 (the trivia card) uses the existing layout and has no still. Camera moves and their reasons are in shots_fx.json ("why"), chosen by pipeline/CAMERA.md.

bk_43.subject: Wide shot at eye level through a long lens, at the edge of the crowd: in the upper half of the picture a slim Filipina woman of 1898, a wide woven salakot hat pulled low so its deep shadow hides her whole face, a plain blue-grey baro blouse and a long dark brown saya skirt, no coat, no umbrella, carrying on her hip a Filipino toddler boy about two with short black hair in a small off-white shirt, a round bronze medallion the size of a coin on a cord at the boy's neck, seen straight from behind, only the back of the salakot and her back visible, nothing of her face or ear, walking away, her arms around the boy with her hands hidden; the toddler looks back over her shoulder at the viewer with a small smile; the boy wears ONE medallion, he lifts that same medallion away from his chest by its cord, the cord running from his neck to his small hand, no other coin, a plain smooth rim, no letters or marks around the rim; blurred passing bodies of a few clearly different villagers of 1898, varied faces, ages and clothes, no identical people, no duplicates half cover them. No dog. The lower half is only blurred passing bodies.
bk_43.setting: the dirt yard of a large two-storey wooden house over a white stone ground floor in Kawit, Cavite, 12 June 1898: one big front window with wooden shutters on the plain upper floor, NO balcony, no tower, red tiled roof, a bamboo fence, coconut palms; everyone in 1898 clothes: camisa, baro, salakot, buri hats; no modern clothes, no t-shirts, no shorts; no modern buildings, no power lines, no writing anywhere
bk_43.light: late afternoon sun lower now, gold and soft, long shadows, a glint on the medallion, dust like smoke, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork

bk_44.subject: Close-up: in the upper half of the picture a medium-sized slim black short-haired Philippine street dog with a white chest patch, one folded ear and bright clever eyes, a red kerchief around his neck. The dog's left ear stands upright and pointed, only the dog's right ear is folded down; the dog's face is all black with no white on it, the white patch is only on the dog's chest. The dog raises his nose, sniffing the empty air where people just passed, eyes narrowed and suspicious, a faint shimmer of golden dust hanging in the air. No people. The lower half is only dust.
bk_44.setting: the dirt yard of a large two-storey wooden house over a white stone ground floor in Kawit, Cavite, 12 June 1898: one big front window with wooden shutters on the plain upper floor, NO balcony, no tower, red tiled roof, a bamboo fence, coconut palms; no modern buildings, no power lines, no writing anywhere
bk_44.light: late gold afternoon light, a faint unnatural shimmer in the air, soft shadows, rim light on the fur, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork

bk_45.subject: Close-up on two hands, no faces: in the upper half of the picture a boy's small brown hand in a rolled light-blue sleeve lays one wooden drumstick across the open palm of a young man's larger warm brown right hand, a white camisa cuff, two thin straight indigo lines on the forearm; the boy's fingers have just let go, a clear gap between the two hands, the hands not touching. The lower half is only the dust below.
bk_45.setting: the dirt yard of a large two-storey wooden house over a white stone ground floor in Kawit, Cavite, 12 June 1898: one big front window with wooden shutters on the plain upper floor, NO balcony, no tower, red tiled roof, a bamboo fence, coconut palms; no modern buildings, no power lines, no writing anywhere
bk_45.light: late afternoon light, warm and low, the drumstick wood glowing, soft shadow under the hands, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork

bk_46.subject: Medium shot: in the upper half of the picture a young Filipino man about twenty, lean, warm brown skin, short tousled black hair tied in a small topknot, dark brown eyes, a red cloth headband with long tails, wearing a loose white collarless camisa shirt, rolled-up red trousers, barefoot, a bare neck with no cord and no medallion, two thin straight indigo lines on his right forearm, standing in the yard, a wooden drumstick in his right hand, his left fist closed, both hands dissolving into streams of gold light rising upward, his body starting to fade, calm eyes on the drumstick. No dog. The lower half is only dust and gold sparks.
bk_46.setting: the dirt yard of a large two-storey wooden house over a white stone ground floor in Kawit, Cavite, 12 June 1898: one big front window with wooden shutters on the plain upper floor, NO balcony, no tower, red tiled roof, a bamboo fence, coconut palms; no modern buildings, no power lines, no writing anywhere
bk_46.light: his own gold light glowing up from the hands, the afternoon dimming around him, sparks, rim light, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork

bk_47.subject: Wide low side shot, tilting up: in the upper half of the picture the front of the house with its wide wooden balcony across the upper floor; on the lawn before it a young Filipino man about twenty, lean, warm brown skin, short tousled black hair tied in a small topknot, dark brown eyes, wearing a plain white short-sleeved polo shirt, black slacks, a small dark backpack on his shoulders, a bare neck with no cord and no medallion, a red handkerchief tied on his left wrist, no headband, three thin straight indigo lines on his right forearm, seen from the side, looking up at the balcony, his right forearm turned out with the newest line smoking in a wisp of steam, a wooden drumstick in his right hand, his left hand in his pocket. He is alone, no dog, no animals. No plaque in the picture. The lower half is only green lawn.
bk_47.setting: the old Aguinaldo house in Kawit, Cavite, in our time, a heritage shrine: a large two-storey house of dark wood over white stone, WITH a wide wooden balcony across the upper floor, a tall square tower, red tiled roofs, a green lawn, palm trees; no cross, no church, no steeple, no religious statue
bk_47.light: late afternoon sun, long shadows, the balcony lit gold, a thin wisp of steam on his arm, deep blue sky, rim light, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork

bk_48.subject: Two-shot at eye level over the box, camera low at table height: in the upper half of the picture a kind Filipina grandmother about seventy, pale warm skin with soft wrinkles, medium grey hair pulled back smoothly into a low bun, round glasses with thick dark rims, a pale grey-white short-sleeved house dress printed with pink, peach and yellow flowers, smiling across the table at a young Filipino man about twenty, lean, warm brown skin, short tousled black hair tied in a small topknot, dark brown eyes, wearing a plain white short-sleeved polo shirt, black slacks, a small dark backpack on his shoulders, a bare neck with no cord and no medallion, a red handkerchief tied on his left wrist, no headband, three thin straight indigo lines on his right forearm, seen three-quarter from behind, both his arms below the table edge out of sight, no hands visible; just above the middle of the picture on the table the open old wooden box with one medallion in it, a plain smooth bronze disc with only a simple sun and triangle relief, a plain smooth rim, no letters or marks around the rim, beside it a drumstick and a bowl of cold sinigang. One medallion only. No dog, no animals. The lower part is only the near table edge.
bk_48.setting: the kitchen of a modest old wooden house in Kawit, Cavite, in our time: a worn wooden table, sliding capiz shell windows, plank walls, old framed family photographs, a small electric fan; no writing anywhere
bk_48.light: warm evening lamplight, deep soft shadows, the medallion glowing in the box, the window dark blue behind, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork

bk_49.subject: Close-up, high angle, slow: in the upper half of the picture an old woman's hand with soft wrinkled pale warm skin, a short sleeve of a pale grey-white house dress printed with pink, peach and yellow flowers, closing the lid of the small old dark wooden box; the lid half closed, held by her fingertips at the lid's back edge; through the narrow gap a bronze glint INSIDE the box, the medallion vanishing under the lid; nothing on top of the box, no letters. One hand only. No dog, no animals. The lower half is only the worn table grain.
bk_49.setting: the kitchen of a modest old wooden house in Kawit, Cavite, in our time: a worn wooden table, sliding capiz shell windows, plank walls, old framed family photographs, a small electric fan; no writing anywhere
bk_49.light: a single warm lamp beam on the box, everything else in deep brown shadow, the last glint of bronze, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork

bk_50.subject: Insert shot at eye level, a still life: in the upper half of the picture a wide flat plain cream paper card, completely blank, propped flat-on against the plank wall, big and square to the viewer; on the table below it a single wooden drumstick lying across the worn wood. No people, no dog, no animals. The lower half is only the table and the drumstick.
bk_50.setting: the kitchen of a modest old wooden house in Kawit, Cavite, in our time: a worn wooden table, sliding capiz shell windows, plank walls, old framed family photographs, a small electric fan; no writing anywhere
bk_50.light: warm evening lamplight from one side, soft shadow of the drumstick, deep brown shadows at the edges, richly painted, detailed ink linework, textured brushwork
